defs.def: a female chicken, often kept for its eggs or meat 母鸡

ex.s: Staff in care homes have reported a reduction in the use of medicine where hens are in use.
ex.t: 养老院的工作人员报告说，在有母鸡的地方，药物用量减少了。

ex.s: She said: “I used to keep hens when I was younger and had to prepare their breakfast each morning before I went to school. ”
ex.t: 她说："我年轻时也养过母鸡，每天早上上学前得给它们准备早餐。"

ex.s: I am down there in my wheelchair in the morning letting the hens out and down there again at night to see they’ve gone to bed.”
ex.t: 我早上坐着轮椅下去放母鸡，晚上又下去看它们睡觉。"

ex.s: People have been bringing their children in to see the hens and residents come and sit outside to watch them.
ex.t: 人们带着孩子来看母鸡，居民们也出来坐在外面观看它们。

ex.s: There are now 700 elderly people looking after hens in 20 care homes in the North East, and the charity has been given financial support to roll it out countrywide.
ex.t: 如今英格兰东北部20家养老院里有700名老人在照料母鸡，该慈善机构已获得财政支持，计划在全国范围内推广。

defs.def: any female bird 尤用于构成复合词
